Planning Commission Regular Meeting
PLANNING COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday MAY 14, 2020
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE OT THE FLAG
3. ADMINISTRATION OF OATH TO NEWLY APPOINTED PLANNING COMMISSIONER CHRISTINA FRAGA-SAENZ
4. ROLL CALL: CHAIR NEMETH, VICE CHAIR AVERY, COMMISSIONERS FRAGA-SAENZ, HENDERSON AND SMITH
5. REVIEW OF AGENDA
6. MOTION TO WAIVE FULL READING OF ALL RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA FOR THIS MEETING
7. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS AND ANY ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA
8. CONSENT CALENDAR: APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES FROM THE REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING OF APRIL 9, 2020.
9. PUBLIC HEARINGS
9A. Appeal 20-001
Mr. Ben Sayani and Mr. Fred Matian, Appellants
An appeal of the Deputy Director of Economic and Community Development's interpretation regarding allowable uses within the Antelope Valley Business Park Specific Plan for the development of an automotive auction use located south of Avenue M and west of 10th Street West.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-020 upholding the Deputy Director of Economic and Community Development's interpretation, denying Appeal 20-001 and finding that the appeal is not subject to California Environmental Quality Act. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
9A
9B. Conditional Use Permit 20-003
Kaze Sushi, Applicant
A request to establish a Type 41 Alcoholic Beverage Control License for the sale and dispensing of beer and wine for onsite consumption at a bonafide restaurant, located at 40117 10th Street West, Suite A.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-018 approving Conditional Use Permit 20-003 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Clarence "Skip" Smith, Assistant Planner
9B
9C. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 20-002
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to amend the Palmdale Municipal Code to modify the standards for amusement arcades and amusement machines.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-019 recommending that the City Council approve Zoning Ordinance Amendment 20-002 and find that the project is exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
9C
10. STAFF COMMUNICATIONS
Carlene Saxton, Acting Planning Manager
11. PLANNING COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS
12. ADJOURNMENT TO THE REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING OF THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2020, AT 7:00 P.M., IN THE CITY OF PALMDALE CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
www.ci tyofpalmdale.org
Auxiliary Aids provided for Communication Accessibility upon 72 hour notice and request.
